variants.blocker: Approved expanded White source exists, but canonical transparent production PNG is not present.
variants.unblockAction: Export the approved expanded White source non-destructively to the canonical PNG and pass geometry, alpha-edge, framing, file-budget and Flutter integration QA.

variants.blocker: Current real Gray source is collapsed and cannot truthfully provide expanded parity without reconstruction.
variants.unblockAction: Provide/approve a faithful expanded Gray source, or explicitly approve a collapsed Gray canonical presentation; then export and pass canonical QA.

variants.blocker: Approved Blue source exists, but canonical transparent production PNG is not present.
variants.unblockAction: Produce the canonical transparent Blue cutout while preserving the four-compartment SUS304 tray, accessories and material highlights, then pass alpha/framing/file-budget QA.

variants.blocker: Approved Pink source is embedded in a marketplace screenshot; canonical clean product-only PNG is not present.
variants.unblockAction: Extract only the approved clean product panel, exclude marketplace/title/rating/navigation pixels, then export and pass canonical QA.

variants.blocker: Approved Green source exists with a different camera/layout; canonical normalized production PNG is not present.
variants.unblockAction: Normalize canvas, scale and optical center without reconstructing geometry, then export and pass alpha/framing/file-budget QA.

visualAcceptanceLifecycle.passRule: PASS requires the real canonical asset plus reference/runtime visual inspection; painted fallback never proves product-photo acceptance.
visualAcceptanceLifecycle.reopenRule: Any visual, product-truth, alpha, mapping, performance or accessibility regression reopens the affected acceptance row before a new stable owner-visible publication.
